title: Smiling Woman with Glasses & Jacket, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white candid snapshot of a young woman smiling at the camera outdoors on a sunny day. She is wearing round eyeglasses, a short-sleeved collared blouse, cuffed trousers, and carries a dark jacket folded over her arm. The background shows a grassy yard and trees under a bright sky. Taken on May 30, 1947, reflecting post-WWII American suburban life and women's casual fashion.
